ticker_news.title: If I Could Only Buy and Hold a Single Stock, This Would Be It
ticker_news.description: The article recommends the VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH) as a relatively safe investment option, highlighting its strong historical performance of averaging 31% annual returns over 10 years and providing exposure to 26 top semiconductor stocks.
ticker_news.author: Will Healy

ticker_news.title: 2 Core AI Infrastructure Stocks I'd Buy Now
ticker_news.description: Despite recent stock sell-offs, Nvidia and CoreWeave remain strong AI infrastructure investments with long-term growth potential, offering attractive entry points for patient investors interested in the AI computing megatrend.
ticker_news.author: George Budwell
